selene_briefing_draft: Good morning. Saturday is looking solid on the estate-sale side, especially northeast and northwest corridors. Several multi-day sales are still open with furniture, tools, and collectibles. It will be hot — high near 93 — so the best window is early. Get to the high-value stops before 9 if you can. More garage and yard listings are still clearing verification.
